title: Estimate config
description: Validates the hand-authored estimate config (examples/*.estimate.yaml). YAML is parsed to JSON before validation. Structure, styling, and formulas come from units.yaml + tokens.yaml; this file is only quantities, crews, and prices.

^x-.description: Namespaced consumer passthrough (#257): any key prefixed 'x-' is accepted verbatim so a consumer can persist its own metadata (e.g. which basis produced the sheet) without a schema bump. Non-prefixed unknown keys still fail.

markup.description: Bond/markup dollars, or a formula such as '=E{row:subtotal}*0.10' for a percentage markup that reflows when items change. The cover derives the % from it.

cost_code_system.description: Which coding library the item/labor/cost-detail cost_code strings belong to. Documentation only - the builder does not resolve codes. Generic across every pack.

source.description: Where the library lives, e.g. a BidSheet.ai cost code system id.

rate_table.description: Master crew rates -> MOB!J13 down, the global VLOOKUP target; the range spans the trades declared.

crews.description: Optional crew composition table. Referenced from item.crew_id.

id.description: Unique crew identifier across crews[]. Cross-uniqueness enforced at build time.

numOrFormula.description: A literal number or an Excel formula string beginning with '='.

^x-.description: Namespaced consumer passthrough (#257): any key prefixed 'x-' is accepted verbatim (e.g. the work-type profile that produced the item's cost blocks). Non-prefixed unknown keys still fail.

sheet.description: Excel sheet name (<=31 chars). The mobilization item's sheet name is what crew VLOOKUPs reference.

labor.description: Optional: an item priced purely from spreads/cost_details, with no labor block, is legitimate.

wbs.description: Optional WBS identifier, free-form (e.g. '1.2.3' or 'A.10.4'). No format validation.

cost_code.description: Optional cost-code reference (e.g. '02-110'). Free-form string; resolution to a category is a profile / render concern.

optional.description: Optional: true when the item is an alternate / optional bid item. Documentation only - resolution to a bid-item grouping is a profile / render concern.

in_summary.description: False on a shared-cost sheet whose TOTAL is pushed into the items that pay for it (each holds a share of it as a cross-sheet {ref:SHEET!NAME} formula). The cover then omits the sheet, so its dollars reach the bid exactly once. The sheet is still rendered and still publishes its total.

crew_id.description: Optional reference to an id in the top-level 'crews:' array. Cross-reference is enforced at build time by validate.py, not by the schema.

estimate_item_id.description: Optional mirror of BidSheet.ai EstimateItem.pk. Set by BM sync; absent on locally-drafted items until first push. Used by parse_compact as the primary row-identity anchor.

scaffold_meta.description: Provenance written by `est-estimate scaffold` (scaffold.py). `source` names where the item's prefill came from (bid_frame / bm:scaffold:<id> / profile:estimate_scaffolds.yaml); `field_hashes` holds a content hash per scaffold-owned field so apply-takeoff can detect hand edits. `schedule` and `official_qty` mirror the bid frame for row matching and the official-vs-measured advisory.

note.description: Optional aside shown on the title row, e.g. "@ 8 hours / pours".

cost_code.description: Optional cost-code reference for this labor block. Free-form; resolution to a category is a profile / render concern.

count.description: A half-crew (e.g. one operator shared across two crews) is legitimate; not only whole members.

days.description: Optional: a crew priced by factor rather than by days carries none.

cost_code.description: Optional cost-code reference for this cost-detail block. Free-form; resolution to a category is a profile / render concern.

unit_price.description: A formula is allowed, so a line can hold a share of a shared-cost sheet pulled in with a cross-sheet {ref:SHEET!NAME}.
